errors.evidence: The description states that there are five selected countries besides Bulgaria, but the chart shows six other countries: Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Croatia, Romania, and Slovenia. The count is incorrect.
The description completely omits the data series for Slovenia (Словения), which is present in the chart as a dark grey dashed line.
The value for Bulgaria in 2012 is approximately 0.14%, not 0.13% as stated.

errors.text_span: и се стабилизира около 0.10–0.11% до 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The line for Estonia does not stabilize around 0.10-0.11%. It ends at approximately 0.08% in 2017.

errors.text_span: Линията за Хърватия (сиво-пунктирана) започва около 0.15% през 2007 г., спада до 0.12% през 2010 г., след това постепенно се повишава до 0.15% през 2017 г.
